summary: US forces conducted a sixth consecutive night of attacks on Iran, striking military positions, power infrastructure, bridges and a port logistics hub at Bandar Abbas. Iranian missile and drone attacks targeted US bases in Jordan, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, with American troops wounded in Jordan. Regional escalation is intensifying across the Middle East as multiple Gulf states report interceptions and infrastructure damage.
key_points: US attacks for a sixth night hit dozens of military positions, power infrastructure and several bridges in southern Iran including Bandar Abbas logistics routes (Source: @mamlekate/103913).
Two missiles struck the US Muwaffaq al-Salti base in Jordan, with Patriot systems activated to intercept the attack (Source: @naya_foriraq/83783).
CBS cited US officials saying American troops were wounded at two Jordan bases this week from Iranian attacks on facilities (Source: @SharghDaily/172688).
Four rockets directly hit the Isa Air Base in Bahrain according to a channel report (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378591).
Iran attacked water desalination and power generation facilities in Kuwait, damaging multiple power generation units (Source: @asafroz/51568).
Multiple explosions were reported in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, with a US strike near the city at 03:50 local time (Source: @shin_persian/8094).
US expected to send 10 refueling aircraft to Israel in next 24 hours, 5 already en route, not landing at Ben Gurion (Source: @inon_yttach/9514).
Iranian missiles targeted US bases in Saudi Arabia and air defenses in Kuwait intercepted hostile drones after Iranian aggression (Source: @SharghDaily/172686).

points: US attacks for a sixth consecutive night struck dozens of military positions, power infrastructure and several bridges in southern Iran, with Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar reporting threats (Source: @mamlekate/103913). A US official said several bridges and supply routes to the Bandar Abbas naval base at the Strait of Hormoz were targeted to cut logistics.

US strikes hit areas in Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Lar, Darab and Yazd with missiles; no casualty figures released. Separate explosions were heard around Yazd between 1:00 and 1:10 AM (Source: @SharghDaily/172681, @mamlekate/103935). Iranian media also reported attacks on a missile site on the Gerash-Lar road.

Multiple explosions were reported in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province; Mehr News said a point near Bandar Abbas was struck at 03:50 local time / 0020Z with assessment ongoing (Source: @shin_persian/8094, @shin_persian/8095, @rodast_omiddana/76730). The Bandar Abbas-Rudan bridge in Hormozgan was also cited.

Enemy attacks struck three additional bridges and a tunnel in Hormozgan: Shohada Mirzaei tunnel blocked, Shur River bridge on Bandar Abbas-Sirjan route hit, and Minab-Rudan three-way axis bridge attacked (Source: @SharghDaily/172682). Authorities urged citizens to avoid these routes.

Explosions were reported in Sirik, southern Iran, with two locals telling Faytuks Network; Iranian TV also reported explosions in Sirik (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5084, @N12chat/217903). Sounds of explosions were also reported in Omidiyeh, Khuzestan.

Ballistic missile launches were heard from Tabriz and Khorramabad; two explosions heard in Khorramabad believed at Imam Ali garrison (Source: @kianmeli1/89496, @kianmeli1/89499, @rodast_omiddana/76733). Iranian forces claimed attacking an Iranian vessel in the Indian Ocean per Iran army.

Iranian Revolutionary Guards announced attacks on the al-Udeid US base in Qatar and warned further US attacks on Iran would bring harsher responses at American bases (Source: @yediotnews25/132819). Iran also attacked water and power facilities in Kuwait per Kuwaiti reports.

US expected to send 10 refueling aircraft to Israel in the next 24 hours, 5 already en route, not landing at Ben Gurion airport (Source: @inon_yttach/9514, @New_security8200/202712). The deployment is framed as ahead of widening fighting in Iran.

IDF Southern Command interceptor launched in the Gaza envelope due to false identification; no launch from the Strip occurred (Source: @almogboker78/17732). The event was a mistaken alert with no actual firing.

Military prosecution filed indictment against Shadi Jumaa for murder of Ido Zoldan in Nov 2007; suspect released from PA custody, arrested in Qalqilya in Ephraim Brigade on 26 May by IDF, Shin Bet, Gideonim 33 (Source: @idf_telegram/24658, @inon_yttach/9510). Charged with intentional homicide in concert.

Several Israeli civilians crossed from Majdal Shams into Syria; IDF searched and returned them, later detained at border and transferred to police (Source: @idf_telegram/24661). Additional attempts to cross from southern Golan Heights were prevented the same day.

Commander of cooperation unit, Lt. Col. A, visited southern Lebanon security zone to deepen operational cooperation between Air Force and ground forces (Source: @New_security8200/202711). Professional dialogue held to strengthen close air support and joint operational response.

A man about 30, apparently Sri Lankan citizen, severely wounded in violence at construction site near Dead Sea hotels, evacuated to Soroka with penetrating injury (Source: @N12chat/217914). Not stated as combat-related.

Attorney General advised ministers Israel entered transition government period, must consult before non-routine decisions (Source: @amitsegal/63132). No operational military detail provided beyond governance constraint.
Occupation forces opened fire toward civilians east of Khan Yunis city in southern Gaza Strip (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378555). No casualties or further detail provided in the message.

Military prosecution filed indictment against Shadi Jumaa for 2007 murder of Ido Zoldan; arrested in Qalqilya in Ephraim Brigade by IDF, Shin Bet, Gideonim 33 unit (Source: @idf_telegram/24658). The terrorist had been held in Palestinian Authority custody until recent release.

IDF Southern Command interceptor exited following false identification in the Gaza envelope; no projectile launched from the Strip (Source: @almogboker78/17732). The incident was a mistaken launch with no real threat.

No additional Gaza or West Bank operational details beyond Khan Yunis firing and the Judah/Samaria indictment and border crossing events were explicitly stated in the provided messages (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378555).

No explicit casualty figures, unit deployments or weapon systems for Gaza/West Bank combat were stated beyond the Khan Yunis firing report (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378555).

The only West Bank judicial item is the 2007 murder indictment filed in military court against a released PA-held terrorist (Source: @inon_yttach/9510). No current West Bank raid or operation described.

The southern Lebanon security zone engagement is the only Lebanon-specific operational item, focused on IDF internal cooperation not external clash (Source: @New_security8200/202711).

Two missiles struck the US Muwaffaq al-Salti base in Jordan where US forces are stationed, with Patriot systems activated to intercept (Source: @kianmeli1/89505, @naya_foriraq/83783). CBS said US troops wounded at two Jordan bases this week.
Four rockets directly hit the Isa Air Base in Bahrain according to a channel report (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378591). No casualty figures provided in the message.

Iran attacked water desalination and power generation facilities in Kuwait; multiple power generation units damaged, per Kuwaiti government Friday statement (Source: @asafroz/51568, @yediotnews25/132819). Kuwaiti air defenses intercepted hostile drones after Iranian aggression.

Kuwait International Airport temporarily stopped operations due to Iranian missile attacks; a passenger plane from Jordan struggled to land (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378552). Kuwaiti fire crews controlled fires per later report.

Iranian missiles targeted US bases in Saudi Arabia; Arabic media reported military bases hit (Source: @SharghDaily/172686, @kianmeli1/89503). First Iranian attack on Saudi Arabia in four months per Israeli media.
Revolutionary Guards said they attacked al-Udeid US base in Qatar and warned of worse responses; Kuwait desalination and power plant hit (Source: @yediotnews25/132819). Qatar not otherwise detailed.
Kuwait, Bahrain and Qatar reported attacks, explosions and increased security threat levels alongside US strikes on Iran (Source: @mamlekate/103913). Gulf air defenses active across the region.

sections.threat_assessment: Iran is conducting coordinated missile and drone attacks on US bases across Jordan, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait, with confirmed strikes on Isa Air Base and Kuwaiti infrastructure and wounded US troops in Jordan. The US is widening its air campaign against Iranian military and logistics nodes at Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan bridges and southern cities, raising risk of ground escalation as refueling aircraft flow to Israel. Israeli border and judicial events show secondary strain but no direct Israeli-Iran exchange stated. Gulf air defenses are actively intercepting, indicating sustained multi-state exposure.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait activated air defenses against hostile drones and temporarily closed its international airport after Iranian attacks, with fire crews managing strikes on power and desalination sites. Saudi Arabia and Qatar were named as targets of Iranian base attacks, prompting alarm over regional war spread. Jordan used Patriot interceptors at Muwaffaq al-Salti and sounded sirens after missile fire. Israel is receiving US refueling aircraft ahead of potential wider operations, while IDF deepened Lebanon coordination absent reported hostilities.
sections.intelligence_notes: Source stream is heavily Tehran-centric with overlapping Iranian, Israeli and Arab channel reports; casualty figures are absent except US wounded in Jordan and no Gaza/West Bank combat data beyond Khan Yunis fire. Reported US bridge strikes on Bandar Abbas-Rudan and Shur River routes suggest deliberate logistics isolation of the Hormoz Strait naval base. Kuwaiti drone interception and airport pause show Iranian pressure on Gulf critical infrastructure. IDF Southern Command false intercept shows alert strain; Lebanon visit indicates preparedness not engagement.
